title: Bar Drop Blueberry Cherry Cranberry 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Bar Drop Salts Blueberry Cherry Cranberry by Drop is a complex trio of dark and red berries. It starts with the soft, ripe sweetness of blueberries, which is quickly deepened by the rich, dark juice of cherries. On the exhale, a sharp note of tart cranberry emerges, cutting through the sweetness to provide a balanced, multi-layered fruit experience that evolves with every draw. Mixed at a 40% VG / 60% PG ratio, this e-liquid is engineered for high-definition flavour. The higher PG content ensures that the subtle differences between the three berry types are distinct and vivid. Perfect for MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) vaping, the nicotine salt blend offers a gentle throat hit in 5mg, 10mg, or 20mg strengths. Bar Drop Salts is a range of nic salt e-liquids from UK manufacturer, Drop, that specialises in creating fruity flavours of astonishing authenticity and clarity.
